scope: Real Pi/GLM on an existing independently verified V12 Box, through the local authenticated API and HTTPS model gateway. A disabled routine was invoked once through its manual test endpoint while ordinary chat ran concurrently.

measurements.durationBasis: Persisted run created_at to finished_at, including preparation.

limits: This checks independent main/background execution and model-request accounting. It does not test a clock-fired schedule or hosted authenticated activation.
Single real model sample; it is not a sustained concurrency or latency guarantee.

publicCanary.recoveryValidation: Passed against the completed journal without creating another routine or model run. Re-read owner-scoped API results and the independent Box file.
publicCanary.durationBasis: The public canary reports preparedAt to finishedAt when present; these durations exclude preparation.
